title: Check landholding eligibility
description: Confirm that your family meets the current PM-KISAN landholding rules and that no scheme exclusion applies.

title: Prepare your details
description: Keep your Aadhaar, active mobile number, bank account details and land-record information ready. Check the official portal for the current document requirements.

title: Submit the registration or correction
description: Use the official PM-KISAN portal or an authorized service centre, complete the applicable registration or correction process, and follow the on-screen verification instructions.

title: Save the reference and track verification
description: Save the acknowledgement or registration number and check the application status on the official portal. The relevant State or Union Territory authorities verify records.

title: Check the crop and season notification
description: Confirm with your State agriculture department, insurer or official PMFBY portal that your crop, location and season are notified and note the enrolment deadline.

title: Prepare the required information
description: Keep your identity and bank details, land or eligible cultivation documents, crop name, insured area and sowing information ready. Requirements can vary by State and season.

title: Enrol through an authorized channel
description: Apply before the notified deadline through the official PMFBY portal or an applicable bank, service centre or State-authorized channel. Review the crop, area and premium details before submitting.

title: Save your acknowledgement and report losses promptly
description: Keep the application and payment acknowledgement. If crop loss occurs, follow the current State and insurer instructions and report it within the applicable time limit.

title: Contact a participating bank
description: Ask a participating bank about its Kisan Credit Card application process, eligible activities, required documents and current terms.

title: Prepare the application documents
description: Gather the identity, address, bank and land or cultivation documents requested by the bank. Tenant farmers and sharecroppers should ask which cultivation evidence the bank accepts.

title: Complete and submit the KCC application
description: Fill in the bank's KCC application with accurate crop, activity and credit-limit information, attach the requested documents and submit it to the bank.

title: Complete bank verification
description: Respond to any requests for additional information. The bank reviews eligibility and credit details; ask it to explain the approved limit, interest, repayment and renewal terms before accepting.

title: Contact the local agriculture office
description: Ask your local agriculture department or soil-testing laboratory how to request a soil test and whether a field visit or sample drop-off is used in your area.

title: Provide field details and arrange sampling
description: Share the field location and crop details requested by the local service. Follow its instructions for collecting, labelling and submitting a representative soil sample.

title: Collect your Soil Health Card or test report
description: Ask the local service when and where the test result will be available, and check that the report corresponds to your field.

title: Review and use the recommendations
description: Use the soil and nutrient recommendations for crop planning. Ask an agriculture officer to clarify advice that is unclear or does not fit your field.
